judged_text: In sync mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo` is a raw fetch Response instead of an axios response, so the unchanged `if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error)` throws TypeError on undefined `.data`. Zoho CRM token refresh crashes with an unhandled error on every refresh when credential sync is enabled, breaking Zoho CRM calendar sync for all synced users.

Zoho CRM token refresh crashes with an unhandled error on every refresh when credential sync is enabled, breaking Zoho CRM calendar sync for all synced users.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the token refresh call is now wrapped with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and the result is still treated like an axios response (`if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`). But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch` `Response` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy. A `fetch` Response does not have a `.data` property, so in sync mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw, breaking refresh.
